items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: they give Nat King Cole $25,000.00 to do just a tune

ctx.x: All the rest of his instruments are mechanical. They're man-made instruments. That's why singers get more money than players, I guess. Well, they give Nat King Cole $25,000.00 to do just a tune, 'Blue Gardenia'.
That's an interesting theory. I never thought of it that way.
